title: How to layer necklaces without the tangle
excerpt: Three rules for a layered look that stays put through a full day.
content: Start with your shortest chain closest to the neck, vary pendant sizes, and use different chain textures so links don’t catch on each other.

title: Caring for rose gold-plated pieces
excerpt: Simple habits that keep the finish looking new for years.
content: Remove jewellery before showering or applying perfume, store pieces separately to avoid scratching, and wipe with a soft cloth after wear.

title: Building a capsule bag rotation
excerpt: Three bags that cover every occasion without the clutter.
content: One structured tote for work, one crossbody for errands, and one evening bag for occasions covers most weeks without overbuying.
